notes.title: Added a First-Person game mode!
notes.content:
First-Person Game Mode!
Am currently adding a First-Person game mode to Light Dude because why not! It will be included in the next playtest version so make sure you sign up for the playtest. Be prepared for some extra laugh and screams!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478584/3871aa00c0300abc75b91cc3c1baa49aa99bdc4d.gif"]
Make sure you Join the Discord to give feedback about the game!

notes.title: Playtest Demo Available Now On Discord!
notes.content:
I would like to thank everyone who have been following the development of Light Dude. Without you I couldn't have reached this far with the game! Now I can finally say there is a demo for Light Dude that you can try!
The demo includes few levels and a BOSS FIGHT. Just hop into the Discord to get your demo steam key access.
